title: Postman collection
content_data:
We provide a Postman collection for our API endpoints. 

Please click [here](https://tiktok.postman.co/workspace/TikTok-API-For-Business~cf223b0e-a943-4e26-8443-b8618153a70a/collection/33151601-6700a660-d048-429b-9626-500e2f29b7a4?action=share&creator=33151601) to download the collection and modify it to run the API requests. Note that this is not a complete list of our API endpoints.

seo_description: Find and download a Postman collection for API endpoints to help you integrate with our API more quickly.
